test_item_verbatim: The pop-up updates to show a full QWERTY keyboard.

tcs.tc_title: a full QWERTY keyboard is shown for editing the camera name
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. A wired AUX camera is connected
3. The "Edit Name" soft control has been pressed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the pop-up and check that a full QWERTY keyboard is shown
2. Read the keyboard and check that the letter keys A to Z are all present
tcs.expected_result:
1. A full QWERTY keyboard is shown in the pop-up
2. The letter keys A to Z are all present, which is what makes the keyboard full
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: a full QWERTY keyboard is shown for editing the camera name
tcs.test_item:
The pop-up updates to show a full QWERTY keyboard.

(a full QWERTY keyboard is shown for editing the camera name)

reasoning: §31.1.2 載三個驗證點（鍵盤顯示、開始輸入即覆寫預設名、按 OK 確認），三列各驗一個。`full QWERTY` 為逐字；不驗個別按鍵之配置（Core HMI 之鍵盤規格為外部規格，§8.4.2）。
